title: RADAgent: Automating RADseq Pipelines with Private Open-Source LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.33009v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Restriction site-associated DNA sequencing (RADseq) is a family of reduced-representation sequencing methods. It uses restriction enzymes to sample subsets of the genome, therefore allowing multiple individuals to be sequenced and genotyped together at low cost. RADseq is widely used for population genomics, evolutionary biology, marker discovery, and the development of SNP panels, but complete analysis still requires expert coordination across multiple tools and processing stages. Traditional RADseq analysis requires expert coordination of heterogeneous bioinformatics tools, intermediate artifacts, quality-control checks, and parameter-dependent decisions across multiple stages. Although individual steps can be scripted, executing the complete workflow still requires human oversight for state tracking, result validation, and failure handling. translated_title: RADAgent：使用私有开源大语言模型实现RADseq分析流程自动化
translated_abstract: 限制性位点相关DNA测序（RADseq）是一类简化表示测序方法。它利用限制性内切酶对基因组子集进行采样，因此能够以低成本同时对多个个体进行测序和基因分型。RADseq广泛应用于群体基因组学、进化生物学、分子标记发现以及SNP芯片面板的开发，但完整的分析仍需要专家在多个工具和处理阶段之间进行协调。传统的RADseq分析需要专家协调异构的生物信息学工具、中间产物、质量控制检查以及跨多个阶段的参数依赖决策。尽管单个步骤可以通过脚本实现，但执行完整的工作流程仍需要人工监督来进行状态跟踪、结果验证和故障处理。为了自动化这种由专家驱动的协调工作，我们提出了RADAgent，它引入了一个模块化的……
tldr: RADAgent利用私有开源大语言模型自动化RADseq分析流程，将传统上需要专家跨多个阶段协调的异构生物信息学工作流（包括状态跟踪、结果验证和故障处理）实现无人监督执行。
en_tdlr: RADAgent automates RADseq analysis pipelines using private open-source LLMs, enabling unsupervised execution of multi-stage bioinformatics workflows that traditionally require expert coordination for state tracking, result validation, and failure handling.
